positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, built, and deployed secure AI code execution environments in Copilot, leveraging infrastructure as code and robust security controls to safely scale the feature to tens of millions of users worldwide before transitioning ownership to a dedicated team.
- Strengthened AI code execution security by engineering custom kill switches and subdomain controls, enabling the feature to support major production releases.
- Established and stabilized test environments to validate legal compliance of documents across nearly 100 packages.
- Implemented and supported accessibility features across Copilot Artifacts, including keyboard navigation, high-contrast support, and zoom controls for previews.
- Owned document import/export functionality across formats including HTML, Markdown, and Microsoft Word, ensuring reliable interoperability across document workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer APP Intern
positions.description:
• Interned at Amazon under the Amazon Propel Program (APP), which included a 4-week bootcamp overviewing technologies 
such as AWS and Data Structures and Algorithms and an 8-week project with an Amazon team 
• Worked with Alexa team to update internal self-service portal with new functionality to streamline the patching process for an 
automated speech recognition model using JSON, AWS Lambda, and REST APIs  
• Utilized Typescript and ReactJS framework to create a User Interface for this patcher tool, turning a process that could take 
nearly an hour into one that takes a few seconds

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Mentored a group of incoming Freshmen students, introducing them to Penn State and the resources it provides in a 5 Day virtual
program
• Supervised a design team tasked with designing a contactless convenience store, teaching them the engineering design process
and helping to give them experience in teamwork and problem solving
• Continued contact with group over the course of their freshman year to provide advice and support in their transition from high
school to College

- Organization created to help Penn State Branch Campus Engineering students transition to University Park
- Helped lead a group in an engineering competition judged by representatives from sponsor companies including Lockheed Martin and JMT 
- Gave an introductory lesson to programming, showcasing the basics of Python and general programming in a one-on-one setting
